summary.ja: 流れの上流側の値を用い、1次元の一定速度輸送を1次精度で進める基準法。公開例は周期格子の前進Euler更新で、風向きとCFL条件、数値拡散の関係を比較できる。
summary.en: A first-order baseline for one-dimensional constant-speed transport using the upstream value. The released periodic forward-Euler example exposes flow direction, the CFL restriction and numerical diffusion.

code_mapping_scope: Related chapter modules and test files; not a claim that each test covers every named method.

references.label: Courant, Isaacson & Rees (1952). On the solution of nonlinear hyperbolic differential equations by finite differences.
references.scope: Historical upstream-differencing lineage. Only bibliographic metadata were checked; the scalar update and CFL statement here come from the atlas code.

supports.ja: 風上差分に関係する歴史的な一次文献。今回は書誌を確認し、本サイトのスカラー更新式との対応や安定条件はコードから記述する。
supports.en: Historical primary source associated with upstream differencing. The local scalar specialization and stability condition are established from code inspection.

verification.locator: Publisher title, authors, year, volume and pages; full text unavailable.

assumptions: The problem is q_t+a q_x=0 with constant real a on a uniform grid.
The fully discrete difference_step uses forward Euler and switches between backward and forward differences according to the sign of C=a Δt/Δx.
For this linear periodic update, use |C|≤1 for stability and monotonicity. finite_difference alone is a spatial operator and does not specify a time integrator.
units: q may have any consistent unit; x is length, t is time, and a is length/time. C=a Δt/Δx is dimensionless. Released periodic benchmarks are nondimensional.
boundary_conditions: Periodic boundaries are imposed with np.roll. Inflow, outflow and wall boundaries require a separate ghost-state implementation.

limitations.ja: 空間・時間とも1次精度で、一般に波形や接触面を拡散させる。|C|>1ではこの陽的更新の安定性は保たれない。一定速度のスカラー例だけから、変係数・非線形系や多次元での保存性・安定性は保証しない。
limitations.en: First order in both space and time and generally diffusive for waves and contacts. The explicit periodic update is unstable for |C|>1. This constant-speed scalar example establishes no conservation or stability guarantee for variable-coefficient, nonlinear-system or multidimensional extensions.

metadata_review.level: method-specific source-and-code inspection; no numerical rerun; reference access recorded individually

assumptions_ja: 対象はq_t+a q_x=0、一定の実速度a、一様格子である。
公開の完全離散更新difference_stepは前進Eulerで、C=a Δt/Δxの符号に応じて後退差分と前進差分を切り替える。
この線形周期更新の安定性・単調性には|C|≤1を用いる。finite_difference単独は空間演算子であり時間積分法を指定しない。
units_ja: qの単位は任意だが一貫させる。xは長さ、tは時間、aは長さ/時間で、C=a Δt/Δxは無次元。公開の周期ベンチマークは無次元化されている。
boundary_conditions_ja: np.rollによる周期境界。流入・流出や壁境界を扱うにはゴースト値の実装が別途必要で、現在の周期演算子をそのまま転用しない。

problem.ja: 一定速度で運ばれるスカラー分布の時間発展。
problem.en: Time evolution of a scalar distribution transported at constant speed.

variant.ja: advection.pyの符号対応1次風上差分。difference_stepは前進Euler、finite_differenceは周期空間微分を提供する。
variant.en: Sign-aware first-order upstream differencing in advection.py: forward Euler in difference_step and a periodic spatial derivative in finite_difference.

ja: 一定速度の周期移流で、安定性と数値拡散を分けて学ぶ。
高次法の比較用に簡単で単調な基準更新が必要で、|C|≤1を満たせる。
en: Study stability and numerical diffusion for constant-speed periodic advection.
Use a simple monotone baseline for comparison with higher-order methods when |C|≤1 can be enforced.

ja: 小さな拡散で細部を長時間保つ必要がある。
変速度の保存則や非周期境界を追加処理なしで解きたい。
en: Long-time preservation of fine features with little numerical diffusion is essential.
Variable-speed conservation laws or nonperiodic boundaries are required without additional treatment.

reason.ja: 速度符号による分岐と更新式を確認。
reason.en: The sign branches and update formula were inspected.

reason.ja: コードのCとdxの関係から単位を明示。
reason.en: Units follow from the Courant number and grid spacing.

reason.ja: 増幅率関数と既存テストの対象範囲に限定。
reason.en: Claims are limited to the amplification function and existing test coverage.

summary.ja: advection.pyのfinite_difference・difference_step・amplificationとtest_numerics.pyの離散Fourierモード、周期平均保存、差分方向・次数の既存テストを読んだ。今回の再実行はしていない。
summary.en: Inspected finite_difference, difference_step and amplification in advection.py, plus existing discrete-Fourier-mode, periodic-mean and stencil-direction/order tests in test_numerics.py. No rerun was performed.

ja: 今回の数値再実行、非周期境界、変係数輸送の検証。
Courant–Isaacson–Rees原報の本文との逐式照合。
en: No numerical rerun, nonperiodic-boundary validation or variable-coefficient transport validation.
No equation-by-equation comparison with the Courant–Isaacson–Rees full text.
